title: From Y to School Hoop
bigQuestion: How did basketball move from a YMCA gym into Illinois school gyms?

story.title: A Second Handbook
story.kicker: A Smith College teacher writes a different set of rules for her students.
paragraphs: The Springfield game was not the only paper for long. In 1892 Senda Berenson adapted basketball at Smith College. The reading keeps the name, the place, and the date together.
Her rules divided the court into zones. The women's game had its own handbook, not only a copy of Naismith's list. The reading keeps the name, the place, and the date together.
Illinois schools later built gyms and joined IHSA series. Boys basketball crowned a first state champion in 1908. Girls basketball crowned a first champion in 1977.
The Y sent the seed. School boards heated the rooms. Two dates, 1908 and 1977, mark Illinois paper, not the invention itself. The reading keeps the name, the place, and the date together.
story.think: Why might one invention need more than one rule book?

lessons.title: Senda Berenson at Smith College
lessons.mainIdea: In 1892 Senda Berenson adapted basketball for women at Smith College.
reading: Senda Berenson taught physical education at Smith College in Northampton, Massachusetts. In 1892 she adapted Naismith's game for her students.
Her rules divided the court into zones so players stayed in sections. The women's game had its own paper.
Berenson's work matters because the gym game split early. One invention became more than one handbook.

words.d: the Smith College teacher who adapted basketball for women in 1892
the Massachusetts college where Berenson taught

lessons.title: More Than One Paper
lessons.mainIdea: Basketball traveled as more than one rule book, not as one frozen list.
reading: Naismith's thirteen rules were the seed. Berenson's zones were another list. Later school books grew again.
When a game has two handbooks, historians must name which paper they mean.
This course will not flatten those lists into one slogan.

words.d: a printed rule book for one version of the game
the first short list that later books grew from

lessons.title: Women on the Early Court
lessons.mainIdea: Women played the gym game early, with paper of their own.
reading: Sometimes people tell basketball as only Naismith and men. Berenson's 1892 work shows women in the first years.
Naming her does not finish the story of who was shut out. It stops the false story that women arrived a century late.
Later chapters will ask who else was missing. This chapter plants the second handbook.

words.d: the first years of the gym game, including 1892
kept off a roster or out of a handbook

lessons.title: IHSA Boys Basketball, 1908
lessons.mainIdea: The IHSA crowned its first boys basketball state champion in 1908.
reading: The IHSA began in 1900. Boys basketball crowned a first state champion in 1908.
That is an Illinois school date. It sits after Springfield 1891 and after Berenson 1892.
A state series needs gyms the districts already built. The association writes the meet. The towns heat the buildings.

words.d: an IHSA tournament that names a state champion
the Illinois High School Association, begun in 1900

lessons.title: IHSA Girls Basketball, 1977
lessons.mainIdea: The IHSA crowned its first girls basketball state champion in 1977.
reading: Girls basketball in the IHSA crowned a first state champion in 1977. That is sixty-nine years after the boys' first title.
The gap is a history fact about school institutions. It is not proof that girls did not play earlier in gyms and colleges.
Berenson's 1892 handbook and the 1977 IHSA title are different papers in different rooms.

words.d: the years between two official series dates
a state championship named by the IHSA

look.title: Two different papers
look.text: IHSA records list 1908 for the first boys basketball champion and 1977 for the first girls basketball champion. College women had played long before 1977.

lessons.title: Who Heats the Gym
lessons.mainIdea: Basketball needed a heated indoor room a town or school would pay for.
reading: Without a gym, Naismith's game has no winter home. Parks close at dusk and freeze.
School boards later built gyms for class and for night games. Those rooms made Friday basketball possible in Illinois towns.
The civic fact is the same as the lighted football field: people paid together for a shared floor.

words.d: an indoor school or YMCA room built for class and games
the public body that approves money for a gym

lessons.title: Title IX Is Later Paper
lessons.mainIdea: A 1972 federal education law later changed who schools had to make room for.
reading: Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972 is a U.S. law about sex discrimination in education programs that get federal money.
School sports are part of that story. This chapter only names the law and the year. Later units will return to it.
1972 is not 1892 and not 1977. Keep the three papers separate.

words.d: a 1972 U.S. education law about sex discrimination in funded programs

lessons.title: Naismith at Kansas
lessons.mainIdea: James Naismith later coached at the University of Kansas, beginning in 1898.
reading: After Springfield, Naismith became the basketball coach at the University of Kansas in 1898. He also taught other work at the school.
Kansas became a famous basketball campus later. Naismith himself did not chase a national championship style. He had invented a gym class game.
1898 is a campus date. 1891 is the invention date. Keep both.

words.d: the campus where Naismith coached beginning in 1898
the person hired to run a college team

lessons.title: Basketball at the 1936 Olympics
lessons.mainIdea: Basketball became an Olympic medal sport at Berlin in 1936.
reading: Basketball was a medal sport at the 1936 Olympic Games in Berlin. The United States won the first Olympic gold.
Outdoor courts and rain were part of that tournament. The Olympic stage was not yet the indoor NBA arena people picture now.
1936 is a world-stage date. It sits after Springfield 1891 and after early college games.

words.d: the international meet held every four years
the year basketball became an Olympic medal sport in Berlin
